description:
From: JSON (walk row 14). User-approved 2026-11-25; owner Binary Handling.

Evidence: OtpJSON.decode_start(binary_part(d, 0, c), …) runs on interp, but on run and build fails with: error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: compiler2 native lowering for root 0: native type test cannot read lane-form ShapeId(65) in Executable(…). Passing :binary.copy(...) instead makes it pass. Repro (not minimal: the whole OtpJSON module plus one line, 1,665 lines): /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-752-walk/repro-2026-11-25/05_decode_start_binary_view_arg.fz. Walk: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-752-walk/walk-2026-11-25.md.

Confirmed (Binary Handling, 2026-11-25): ShapeId(65) is ShapeDescr::Cursor { source, position }, reaching the native is_binary test. Bisect: #894 passes and #895 (33060593e) fails. #895 only exposes the bug: fz_binary_part returns `bitstring`, so its result now travels as a cursor where it used to be typed `binary`. Minimal repro (fails on run, passes on interp): `def value(b) when is_binary(b), do: byte_size(b)` with `Main.value(binary_part("[1", 0, 1))`. The fix is in the type test, so that every Cursor gets an answer; lib/erlang.fz is not touched (declaring `:: binary` there would hide the bug). Elixir Parity decides whether the tighter return type is right anyway. Fixture 01829. Builder: ../fz-9e2-17 off cd18bf4ab.

Likely cause (BH, not yet confirmed): native.rs:3611 lane_form_type_test reads only Tuple shapes. The one non-tuple lane form a binary takes is ShapeDescr::Cursor { source, position } (transport.rs:169), so ShapeId(65) is probably a Cursor reaching an is_binary/is_bitstring guard. To confirm, dump --dump native= on the failing build.

Fix direction: a Cursor answers is_bitstring statically true and every other kind statically false. is_binary is read off its lanes as (source bit_len - position) % 8 == 0. This is near fz-9e2.8 (a cursor is a shape only where it is taken apart), but this ticket blocks #791 on the native paths, so it may go first.

Done when: a minimal fixture passes binary_part's result to a function whose guard type-tests it, and matches Elixir on interp, run and build.
title: A type test on a binary slice passed to a function lowers on the native paths
